title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field E as a function of time.

title: Surface Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the surface charge density sigma as a function of time.

title: Magnetic Field Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the magnetic field B as a function of distance from the axis of the disc.

title: Poynting Vector Flux
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the flux of the Poynting vector from the open edges of the capacitor correctly.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for E, sigma, B, and the Poynting vector.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Correct Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the dielectric constant K_e and other relevant constants.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a physical interpretation of the results, enhancing the understanding of the problem.
